nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules Block (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes (APIs, conventions, file structure) differing from training data; agents must read bundled docs and heed deprecation notices before writing code.

nodes.label: Corporate TLS note (--use-system-ca in .npmrc)
nodes.rationale: Needed behind TLS-intercepting proxies (e.g. ITACyL) so Node trusts the machine certificate store; remove if not needed.

nodes.label: Health (module/service)
nodes.rationale: Manual metrics with 7-day averages now; real provider integrations (Garmin, Apple Health, Oura) plug into the service later.

nodes.label: Notifications (module/service)
nodes.rationale: In-app reminders + calendar-derived alerts now; IMAP integration later.

nodes.rationale: Without AI_API_KEY, Daily Brief falls back to a template summary so everything else still works.
